comment: Secret-keyed tool arguments (stigmer#1119). `keys` is the set whose top-level values never reach a reader: the runner redacts them on a row's `args`, in its `args_preview` and in an approval message (backend/services/runner/src/shared/args-preview.ts SENSITIVE_ARG_KEYS), and clients hide them on rows persisted before the runner redacted `args` (@stigmer/sdk isSecretArgKey / redactSecretArgs). Keys match case-insensitively; only top-level keys are secret-keyed, so a nested object is kept whole. `marker` replaces a redacted value. Cases: `args` is a tool call's arguments, `redacted` the expected projection.
